explanation: Jupiter holds more than twice the mass of all the other planets put together, and about 1,300 Earths could fit inside it.

claims.text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Saturn, Neptune and Uranus are all smaller than Jupiter.
Jupiter's mass is more than twice the combined mass of all the other planets.
About 1,300 Earths could fit inside Jupiter by volume.
